subject: chunky mars rover
concept: A stout, boxy Mars rover built from stacked bricks and plates, with six chunky wheels, a raised camera mast, and a solar panel wing on each side, parked calmly on a small red-plate terrain base.
features: six thick round wheels in a low symmetrical stance
boxy body with grey and silver colour blocking
raised mast with a round camera head
two flat solar panel wings jutting from the sides
short bar antenna and a robotic arm stub on the front
simplifications: Replaced posable suspension arms with fixed short bricks connecting wheels to body, since jointed mechanisms aren't buildable
Made the camera mast a short thick stack instead of a thin tall rod, for stability
Turned solar panels into flat tile wings mounted at a fixed angle instead of thin extended panels
Simplified the robotic arm into a short stub bar detail rather than a jointed multi-part arm
Added a small red-plate terrain stand so the rover reads as 'on Mars' without needing a full scene
image_prompt: A studio product photo of an official LEGO set of a chunky stylised Mars rover with six thick round wheels, a boxy grey and silver body, a short raised mast with a round camera head, two flat solar panel wings, and a short antenna bar, parked on a small red terrain base plate, built only from real LEGO bricks and plates, clean colour blocking, calm static pose, whole model in frame, 3/4 view, plain light background.
